verdict.rationale: Rainforest is a SaaS payments platform that holds payment and merchant data, so whether that data can be excluded from AI model training is a fair privacy question. The evidence pack contains no AI-training policy or opt-out control. The statement that platforms retain ownership of their data and can export it is a related data-ownership feature, not a training opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
